summary: FOODbakēd Pass 3 (Menu CRUD + Duplicate + Section reorder + Quick Sold-Out panel + i18n cleanup) tested end-to-end. Backend: 26/26 pytest green (test_food_partner_menu_pass3 4/4 + test_food_partner_menu 9/9 + test_food_dispatch_bridge 7/7 + test_food_orders 6/6). Frontend E2E on live preview verified: FR/EN monolingual rendering with zero bilingual concatenation, Quick Sold-Out strip on both Dashboard and Menu pages, section reorder (up/down + persist across reload + disabled on boundaries), 'Par défaut'/'Default' variant badge (exactly one per item), Duplicate button creates '{name} (Copie)' clone as Épuisé in the same section, Restock button updates strip in-place AND makes item visible on the public /api/food/restaurants/burger_hub_ci/menu endpoint without page refresh.
critical_code_review_comments: MenuManager.jsx uses detectFr() ternary everywhere - works but duplicates the i18n lookup per label; a tiny useMemo-wrapped dict would reduce re-render churn. Non-blocking.
Section reorder uses sequential PATCH loop (not a single bulk endpoint) - acceptable for ≤~20 sections per restaurant but could become slow at scale. Non-blocking.
test_credentials: Partner qa-burger@test.example / QaBurger123! (burger_hub_ci) - works. Super-admin creds not required for this pass.
seed_data_creation: Duplicate test created 1 clone 'Mozzarella Sticks (Copie)' in Starters section via the UI endpoint; restocked via the strip. Harmless demo rows '(Copie)/(Copy)' from earlier passes still present (as expected per request note).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pass 3 Menu CRUD is fully green. If next iteration touches /api/food/manage/*/items/{iid}/duplicate or MenuManager.jsx, re-run backend/tests/test_food_partner_menu_pass3.py plus a quick FR/EN i18n smoke on /partner/food/menu. Language toggle is driven by localStorage keys (baked_lang / lang / i18nextLng) - setting any to 'en' + reload swaps labels; no visible UI switcher found on the partner portal (not in scope here).
rca_of_the_issue: N/A - no bugs encountered. Verified: Duplicate endpoint deep-clones with new IDs (item + variants + addons), honours X-Lang header (default FR -> '(Copie)', en -> '(Copy)'), returns 404 for unknown iid, clone lands with is_available=false. Section PATCH sort_order flows through to the public GET menu ORDER BY sort_order,id. Sidebar sections ('Starters/Entrées', 'Burgers', 'Sides/Accompagnements', 'Drinks/Boissons') render monolingually per locale.
